title: The ringed projection mate commutes with shifts in its direct-image input
statement:
Let $f:(\mathscr X,A_X)\to(\mathscr Y,A_Y)$ be a morphism of ringed topoi presented by sites small in the coefficient universe, with sheaves of commutative rings and a map $f^{-1}A_Y\to A_X$. Use the unbounded derived module-sheaf categories, ordinary K-flat derived tensor, K-injective derived direct image, and canonical derived adjunction of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-projection-mate-exact]. Write $U=Lf^*$, $R=Rf_*$ and $\varepsilon:UR\to1$. Give $U$ its canonical integer-shift structure and $R$ the unique unit/counit-compatible shift structure of [lem-weil-pbc-adjunction-shift-compatibility-unique]. Let $\mu:U(M\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{A_Y}N)\cong UM\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{A_X}UN$ be the canonical pullback tensor comparison. For $K\in D(A_X)$ and $P\in D(A_Y)$ let
$$\pi_{K,P}:RK\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{A_Y}P\longrightarrow R(K\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{A_X}UP)$$
be the adjunct of $(\varepsilon_K\otimes1)\circ\mu_{RK,P}$.

For each fixed $P$, the functors $F_P(K)=RK\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{A_Y}P$ and $G_P(K)=R(K\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{A_X}UP)$ are exact, and $\pi_{-,P}$ is a natural transformation commuting with their induced shift isomorphisms. Explicitly, writing $s_F:F_P(K[1])\cong F_P(K)[1]$ and $s_G:G_P(K[1])\cong G_P(K)[1]$, one has
$$s_G\circ\pi_{K[1],P}=\pi_{K,P}[1]\circ s_F.$$
Thus it gives a morphism of distinguished triangles in the $K$ variable, including the connecting square. No invertibility of $\pi_{K,P}$ is asserted.

proof.text: Apply ringedProjectionMateExact from [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-projection-mate-exact]. Retain its normalized tensor and left/right shift structures, canonical-shift and epsilon compatibility, triangulated right adjoint, shift-compatible adjunction, and exact tensor functors. Composition gives the exact functors F_P and G_P. No independent construction of the derived pullback or right-adjoint shift is needed.

Curry the canonical tensor comparison and compose with curryObjProdComp. The already proved CategoryTheory.Adjunction.rightAdjointProjectionMapFlipApp, in WeilConjectures.CategoryTheory.Adjunction.ProjectionMapShift, gives a natural transformation pi in K. By its defining adjunct formula its component is definitionally derivedProjectionFormulaMate. The first-factor comparison equation from [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-projection-mate-exact] is exactly the CommShift core square of comparisonFlipApp after evaluating and reassociating.

Apply the already proved CategoryTheory.Adjunction.commShift_rightAdjointProjectionMapFlipApp to this comparison. That library theorem expresses the projection mate as whiskerings and composites of the comparison, unit and counit. Stability of shift-compatible transformations under these operations is [lem-weil-pbc-commshift-nattrans-comp-whisker]. The compatible adjunction and all coherent shifts were supplied in step 1. Specialize NatTrans.shift_app_comm at the integer 1 and reverse its equality to obtain the displayed square.

For any triangle take the three components of pi as a morphism between its functor images. The first two squares are pi.naturality. For the third, reassociate F(c), the F shift map and shifted pi; replace the latter two by pi at the shifted object followed by the G shift map, then use naturality at c. These are the equations of [def-weil-pbc-triangles-with-shift]. Both images of distinguished triangles are distinguished by the exactness already established.
